prompt:
EDIT the referenced Gwrach image. Preserve entire composition, anatomy, two wings/two arms, shrivelled hands, pale face, moon and window. Change ONLY all teeth upper and lower: solid DEEP MATTE BLACK ENAMEL, pure charcoal black fang surfaces, no pale ivory, no brown, no golden tips. Shine only minimal grey rim so black fang silhouettes read against burgundy gums and tongue. Long teeth remain same size and count. Source c02 black teeth. No other changes. Original specification: ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mitoloka illustration of Gwrach y Rhibyn, Welsh winged death-herald spirit.
ANATOMY: ONE ugly pale old female harpy-like humanoid, ONE head, TWO eyes, TWO shrivelled human arms, TWO human legs beneath fully opaque ragged black-grey robe, EXACTLY TWO leathery batlike wings from back; tangled withered grey-black hair and conspicuous LONG BLACK TEETH [gwarch-y-rhybin-c02]. Wings are additional to two arms, not wing-arms. No horns, extra heads or glowing eyes.
MOMENT: Swoop up against a dark house window toward viewer, both shrivelled hands clamp outside sill, leathery wings spread behind, head thrust forward and mouth open in a piercing wail revealing long black teeth. No person or victim shown. Robe and tangled hair whip in ordinary air.
POWER: At night she comes to dying person's window and calls their name [gwarch-y-rhybin-c03]; depict wailing gesture only, no written words, soul beam or invented death effects.
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle; from just inside window low angle, close head/blackteeth/hands fill foreground and wings dominate outer darkness.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one dominant low amber moon, deep walnut shadows, strong rim light, ordinary water spray or dust.
SURFACE: tactile wet skin, coarse cloth, scales, hair, old wood and stone; premium painterly brushwork.
SETTING: Welsh house window at night [gwarch-y-rhybin-c03].
MOOD: imposing and active, never cute, calm or decorative. Sacred protective figures remain dignified and reverential.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, pseudoletters, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, eyes, limbs or fingers; no film, game, anime or comic designs; fully opaque clothing on humanoids; no nudity, blood or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline, floating runes or energy ribbons.

rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.

visual_review.notes: Native and 200px inspected: one pale haggard face, tangled hair, two shrivelled hands on sill, two leathery wings; corrected long teeth are black enamel. Window wailing pose c03, no victim. Fully opaque robe, no text/gore/aura, no borrowed design. All seven Sangar criteria pass.

root_visual_review.notes: Viewed native 1254px, 200px, and mouth, both-hand and wing crops. An ugly pale old hag (gwarch-y-rhybin-c02): one head, two eyes, tangled withered grey hair, and pale wrinkled skin. Her mouth gapes in a wail, and every long tooth, upper and lower, is now black (c02 long black teeth; the pale-tooth attempt-01 is fixed). Two shrivelled clawed hands clamp the window sill, and exactly two leathery bat wings rise from her back, separate from the arms. Ragged dark robe, fully opaque. She surges up at a night house window under a full moon, with a stone cottage behind, wailing at the window of the dying (c03). No victim shown. Terrifying and dominant at 200px, with no text, gore, aura or borrowed design.
